entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 6,324 star（日均约 903，相对存量增速 5%），累计 125,245 star、7,944 fork。窗口内被 fork 399 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，468 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 6,324 stars over the last 7 days (~903/day, 5% of its base), now at 125,245 stars and 7,944 forks. 399 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 468 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一款 AI 编程助手，支持在桌面、移动端或云端运行多种编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）。你可以在聊天或终端里与代理交互，甚至让它们并行完成大任务并返回结果。
intro.en: Orca is an AI coding assistant that lets you run multiple coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, and others—on desktop, mobile, or cloud. Chat or terminal interfaces let you interact, and the tool can orchestrate agents to split a big task and bring back results.

cardLine.zh: 多代理 AI 编程助手，支持聊天、终端、并行任务与远程运行。
cardLine.en: Multi‑agent AI coding assistant—chat, terminal, parallel tasks, and remote runtimes.

highlights.zh: 在聊天或终端里直接与任何代理对话，保持上下文无缝切换。
highlights.en: Chat or terminal UI lets you talk to any agent with context preserved across switches.

highlights.zh: 通过工作树并行运行代理，任务拆分后自动聚合结果。
highlights.en: Orchestrate agents in isolated worktrees; split tasks and auto‑merge results.

highlights.zh: 支持远程服务器和云 VM，让代理即使在笔记本睡眠时也能持续运行。
highlights.en: Pair with remote servers or cloud VMs so agents keep running even when your laptop sleeps.

highlights.zh: 移动 App 可随时收到代理提醒，回复聊天保持工作进度。
highlights.en: Mobile app notifies you when an agent needs input, letting you keep work moving on the go.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 8,501 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 8,501 open issues — high relative to its star count

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 stablyai/orca 的 README
# macOS (Homebrew)
# Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask.
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Upgrade an existing install
brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first)
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc

# Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source
yay -S stably-orca-bin
